summary: Humberside airport's opening hours changed, with early and late flights needing prior permission on certain days.
text:
HUMBERSIDE ATZ, ATS AND AD HR OF SRVICE ARE NOW:
MON-WED 0600-0630(PPR), 0730-0830, 0900-1100, 1145-1530, 
        1615-1800, 2040-2135(PPR)
THU-FRI 0600-0630(PPR), 0730-0830, 0900-1530, 1615-1800,
        2040-2135(PPR)
SAT-SUN 0600-0630(PPR), 0900-1530, 1615-1800, 2040-2135(PPR)

TIMES MINUS 15 MINS. INBOUND ACFT SHOULD ALLOW SUFFICIENT TIME TO
